## Verdict
needs-revision

## Concerns
- claim-3 is neither proved nor disproved. Claims 6–7 explicitly concede that the required rectangular-straightening containment is missing.
- claim-5 defines attachment on partitions but not a map carrying each full-coordinate Hopf tensor/row term to an attached Schur-function term.
- No formula for \(F_{\rho,\sigma}\) proves integrality, endpoint coefficients \(1\) and \(-(-1)^{|\rho|}\), or that every residual attachment satisfies \(\sigma\subsetneq\rho\).
- The graded-kernel presentation gives independence of lower-adjoined classes but does not determine the coordinates of the right-adjoined class. The cited finite specialization cannot establish the universal equation.

## Unresolved certificates
- [proof-attempt] Define an explicit termwise attachment map or coefficients \(F_{\rho,\sigma}\) and prove
  \[
  s_{(i^j,\rho)}-(-1)^{|\rho|}
  s_{(i+\rho'_1,\ldots,i+\rho'_b,i^{j-b})}
  =\sum_{\sigma\subsetneq\rho}F_{\rho,\sigma}s_{(i^j,\sigma)},
  \qquad
  F_{\rho,\sigma}\in\Lambda_{|\rho|-|\sigma|},
  \]
  directly from the accepted full-coordinate Hopf identity, including both endpoint coefficients and all boundary conventions; then project to \(A\) and \(Q\).
